review_scope: All 42 question texts, all officially correct candidate texts, and the union of Pool-P/S2-C selected wrong candidate texts were read in full. Other nonselected wrong candidates were not all manually audited. Official reference work was additionally read for cases 1,17,24,32,36,41. These are analyst annotations, not independently adjudicated ground truth or deployable features.
default_confidence: high for the cited observable contradiction; model-internal cause remains unproven

categories.units: 单位换算错误（可伴随算术错误）
categories.quantity_scope: 数量、实体或累计范围混淆
categories.relation_binding: 题意到数量关系的绑定错误
categories.condition_fidelity: 遗漏、改写或添加题目条件
categories.target_binding: 计算中间量但未回答所求量
categories.parser_output: 输出结构与官方解析口径不匹配（可伴随目标错误）
categories.reference_wording: 题面通常含义与参考计算存在疑点
